Who you are
As a packing employee, you are physically fit to stand along the production line during your shift. Further, you fulfill the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week;
- You are at least 18 years old due to working hours;
- You have your own accommodation in the area of Leerdam;
- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are physically fit to pack the glasses at a fast pace;
- You can work at least in the night shift: 21:45-05:45;
- You can work preferably one other extra shift from: 05:45-13:45 or 13:45-21:45.

What will you do
As a packing employee you will work in the glass factory in Leerdam. You have your own place along the production line where you check the glasses for quality. ✨ You then pack them in boxes. 📦 You will receive instructions how exactly the glasses should be packed. After this, you stack the boxes on pallets. These boxes are picked up by your colleague with a forklift. This way, the glasses can be sent to IKEA on time. Let's go! 🚀

Where will you work
